system.description: The spell creates a small wind gust that the enchanter can use to blow away insects, small animals, or small objects (less than 1 kg). It can also extinguish small flames such as candles, torches, or fireplaces.
system.summary: The spell creates a small wind gust that the enchanter can use to blow away insects, small animals, or small objects (less than 1 kg).

powerLevels.effect: Increase the force of the wind gust so that slightly larger animals and objects can be blown away (+1 kg per level of power)
